caption: Each arrow is one handover, labelled with the loss on that leg: 2 kg from farm to transporter, 0 kg to the warehouse, 3 kg to the retailer. The two highlighted arrows are the legs an auditor should investigate; total loss is 5 kg, or 5.0 % of the 100 kg dispatched.

spec.title: Batch B001: 100 kg dispatched, 95 kg received, 5 kg lost (5.0 %)
spec.aria: Farm records q0 = 100 kg, transporter q1 = 98 kg, warehouse q2 = 98 kg, retailer q3 = 95 kg; the arrows between them show losses of 2 kg, 0 kg and 3 kg, and hash pointers link each event to the one before.
